beats.title: pictures over music in the school hallway

beats.text: Ugh *trying to fix her hair* I look ridiculous
Don't worry you look fine *walking with Sonia down the hallway*
You really think so?
I think you look fantastic *blocking their way*
YOU! *tries to hit Scourge but misses*
Hey, no need for violence
WHAT THE F**K ARE YOU DOING HERE?!
Well, just visiting. It's nice to see my ex girlfriends so close as "bffs"
WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE? WALKING INTO OUR SCHOOL WITHOUT PER-
Actually since I'm against your stupid SEGA's I'm allowed to visit whenever I want to
WHAT?!
YOU SHOULD BE F**KING ARRESTED!
All I got was a criminal record
besides, Sal you're prettier than I last saw you
UGH!!
F**king leave her alone!
Don't worry, I think you look prettier from the last time too
*walking towards them* Hey what's-
SCOURGE! BACK AWAY FROM MY SISTER AND GIRLFRIEND!
Oh you're together now? Congrats! I'm not so surprised
*whispers to Sally* What is he doing here?! Shouldn't he be arrested?
*whispers* He's against Sonic in the games and all he got was a criminal record
So since I can't have the chipmunk, I'll have my chances with pinky *smirks at Sonia*
Hmph! In your dreams
WHO ARE YOU CALLING CHIPMUNK?!
Well who else is the chipmunk around here?
NEVER, AND I MEAN NEVER. CALL ME A F**KING CHIPMUNK!
but you are a chipmunk
I PREFER BEING CALLED A SQUIRREL
Chipmunk *smirk*
THAT'S F**KING IT!
CYA BABE! *wink at Sonia and runs off*
GET BACK HERE! *chases after him*
*chuckles* That's my girl
Fixing your hair again?
Nah, it's alright like this
